trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: Express desire to downgrade plan due to high bill.
steps.text: माझं bill खूप जास्त येतंय, मला छोटा plan हवाय.

steps.purpose: Ask for MSISDN to lookup account details.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge the request and ask for the mobile number.
steps.text: नक्कीच, मी तुम्हाला मदत करते. कृपया तुमचा mobile number सांगाल का?
steps.planner_rationale: Need the MSISDN to perform any account lookups.

steps.purpose: Provide MSISDN.
Fetch subscriber details to understand current plan and billing cycle.
Return subscriber details.
Prompt for identity verification factor before making account changes.
steps.expected_behavior: Ask for an identity verification factor before proceeding with plan changes.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. Account मधील बदल करण्यासाठी मला तुमची identity verify करावी लागेल. तुमची जन्मतारीख सांगू शकाल का?
steps.planner_rationale: Identity must be verified before a plan change can be applied, fulfilling mandatory steps.

steps.purpose: Provide date of birth.
Verify identity using the provided date of birth.
Return verification outcome.
Request an alternative verification factor since the first one failed.
steps.expected_behavior: Inform the user of the failure and ask for a different verification factor.
steps.text: माफ करा, ही माहिती match होत नाहीये. तुम्ही तुमचा registered pincode सांगू शकाल का?
steps.planner_rationale: The DOB verification failed, likely due to the STT error, so another factor is needed to verify identity.

steps.purpose: Provide pincode.
steps.text: काय? ठीक आहे, माझा pincode ४११००४ आहे.
steps.clean_text: काय? ठीक आहे, माझा pincode ४११००४ आहे.
steps.model_visible_text: काय? ठीक आहे, माझा pincode ४११००४ आहे.

steps.purpose: Verify identity using the provided pincode.
Return verification outcome.
Fetch available plans to offer a downgrade option.
Return available plans.
Present the available downgrade options based on the catalogue.
steps.expected_behavior: List the plans accurately based on the tool result without inventing details.
steps.text: तुमचा सध्याचा plan PP799 आहे. माझ्याकडे दोन छोटे plans आहेत. एक PP399 ज्याची price ३९९ आहे आणि त्यात २० GB data मिळतो. दुसरा PP599 आहे.
steps.planner_rationale: Grounding the response entirely on the tool output for current plan and available plans.

steps.purpose: Challenge the immediate application of the plan and ask about current data.
steps.text: ३९९ चा plan? पण मला सांगा, हा plan लगेच चालू होईल का? आणि माझं आताचं ४० GB data चं काय होणार? तुम्ही मला काहीही सांगून plan change करू नका.
steps.clean_text: ३९९ चा plan? पण मला सांगा, हा plan लगेच चालू होईल का? आणि माझं आताचं ४० GB data चं काय होणार? तुम्ही मला काहीही सांगून plan change करू नका.
steps.model_visible_text: ३९९ चा plan? पण मला सांगा, हा plan लगेच चालू होईल का? आणि माझं आताचं ४० GB data चं काय होणार? तुम्ही मला काहीही सांगून plan change करू नका.

steps.purpose: Address the sceptical user's concerns by explaining the postpaid cycle rule and current data balance.
steps.expected_behavior: Explain the delay in plan change and reassure the user about their remaining data, using exact figures from the lookup.
steps.text: मी तुम्हाला चुकीची माहिती देणार नाही. Postpaid plan change लगेच लागू होत नाही, तो नेहमी पुढच्या billing cycle पासून चालू होतो. तुमच्या cycle ला अजून १२ दिवस बाकी आहेत. त्यामुळे तुमचा उरलेला ४० GB data तुम्ही पुढचे १२ दिवस वापरू शकता.
steps.planner_rationale: Explaining the business rule that postpaid changes apply next cycle, using the 12 days and 40 GB data from the lookup result.

steps.purpose: Accept the explanation and confirm the plan change.
steps.text: अच्छा, म्हणजे १२ दिवस मला जुनाच plan राहील. ঠিক आहे, मला हे मान्य आहे. मग ३९९ चा plan पुढच्या cycle पासून लागू करा.
steps.clean_text: अच्छा, म्हणजे १२ दिवस मला जुनाच plan राहील. ठीक आहे, मला हे मान्य आहे. मग ३९९ चा plan पुढच्या cycle पासून लागू करा.
steps.model_visible_text: अच्छा, म्हणजे १२ दिवस मला जुनाच plan राहील. ठीक आहे, मला हे मान्य आहे. मग ३९९ चा plan पुढच्या cycle पासून लागू करा.

steps.purpose: Apply the requested plan downgrade.
Return the outcome of the plan change.
Confirm the successful plan change and provide the transaction ID.
steps.expected_behavior: Confirm the transaction using the returned TXN ID and effective date.
steps.text: तुमचा plan change झाला आहे. Transaction ID TXN98765 आहे आणि हा PP399 plan पुढच्या cycle पासून लागू होईल.
steps.planner_rationale: Grounding the confirmation on the apply_recharge tool result, stating the transaction ID and effective date.

ir.terminal_condition: Recharge or migration applied with a transaction id and the effective date stated.
